column7:
Reduction in provision
of ₹5,000.00 lakh was
the net effect of
increase of ₹ 500.00
lakh and decrease by re
appropriation of
₹500.00 lakh and
surrender of ₹5,000.00
lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
Land acquisition item.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Final excess of
₹20,109.86 lakh is
overstated by
₹30,636.83 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹10,526.97
lakh. Reasons for
actual saving have not
been intimated (July
2024).

Augmentation in
provision of ₹25,000.00
lakh was attributed to
need of additional
amounts in Major
construction works item.
Final excess of
₹21,314.01 lakh is
overstated by
₹25,410.93 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹4,096.92
lakh. Reasons for actual
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
